title: MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25105v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. translated_title: MAWAM：面向协同操作的多智能体世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 机器人团队中的每一个动作都会改变其队友必须行动的世界。因此，协同操作需要同时预测团队的动作以及它们共同创造的物理未来。我们提出MAWAM，这是一个多智能体世界-动作模型，能够在单次采样中共同生成每个机器人的未来视角和可执行的动作块。MAWAM基于预训练的单机器人世界-动作骨干网络构建，通过跨智能体注意力机制对所有机器人的动作和未来视角token进行联合去噪，同时为每个机器人保留独立的控制接口。MAWAM在全部三个真实机器人任务（洗衣袋收集、浴巾折叠和雨伞交接）中取得最高成功率，平均成功率达67.8%，比在相同演示数据和相机下训练的MA-VLA高出18.9个百分点。在仿真中，MAWAM在最多四条机械臂协作的八个任务上达到90.3%的平均成功率。消融实验表明跨智能体注意……
tldr: 提出MAWAM多智能体世界-动作模型，通过跨智能体注意力在单次采样中联合生成所有机器人的未来视角和可执行动作，在真实与仿真协同操作任务中大幅超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: MAWAM is a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable actions via cross-agent attention, achieving state-of-the-art performance on coordinated real-robot and simulated manipulation tasks.
